description:
Check a receipt. Three modes, chosen by the arguments given:
1. Hash mode: receipt + expected_hash. Canonicalizes the receipt (JCS, RFC 8785), hashes it with SHA-256 and says whether the digest equals expected_hash. Nothing else about the receipt is checked.
2. Note-receipt mode: receipt alone, whose variant is 'payment-committed-note-v1'. Recomputes note_receipt_hash from the ten cells in note_cells and checks that the fields repeating a cell agree with it. It says only that the receipt is consistent with itself: not that a proof was verified, not that the pool note exists on chain, and nothing about the amount, which no cell carries.
3. Chain mode: tx_hash. Asks the node at STARKNET_RPC_URL which chain it serves (starknet_chainId): Starknet mainnet or Starknet Sepolia, named in network and chain_id with the matching Voyager link; any other chain is refused (status unknown_network) and nothing is read. Then reads the transaction and reports one of two things, checked in this order: on Sepolia only, a PaymentDemoEmitter receipt-hash emission, which moves no value (the receipt rebuilt from the event and its JCS hash), or a STRK Transfer event other than the fee payment (receipt_type starknet-transfer: execution status, block number, amount_wei, sender, recipient; who paid it is not established). A reverted transaction returns verified: false. A transaction that SUCCEEDED but carries neither returns verified: null with status not_a_recognised_payment: it exists and succeeded, and this tool does not read its form, which says nothing against it. A transaction the node does not see, or a read that fails, returns verified: null, never a verdict.
Give either receipt (with or without expected_hash) or tx_hash, not both.

expected_hash.description: Expected SHA-256 hex digest, optionally prefixed with 'sha256:' (hash mode).

receipt.description: The receipt object to check (hash mode, or note-receipt mode when given alone).

tx_hash.description: Starknet tx hash to read (chain mode), on the network the node at STARKNET_RPC_URL serves. E.g. 0x<hex>.

name: verify_receipt
